from pathlib import Path
program = '''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] == 8 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and g[ny][nx] != 8 and (ny, nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            colored = [(y, x) for y, x in cells if g[y][x] != 0]
            if not colored:
                continue
            r0, r1 = min(y for y, x in colored), max(y for y, x in colored)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y, x in colored), max(x for y, x in colored)
            tile = [row[c0:c1+1] for row in g[r0:r1+1]]
            for y, x in cells:
                g[y][x] = tile[(y-r0) % len(tile)][(x-c0) % len(tile[0])]
    return g
'''
